claim: पश्चिम, वायव्य और नैऋत्य दिशा की ओर जमीन का उतार होने पर वह भूमि परिवार के लिए निष्प्रयोजन व्ययकारी होने से अर्थ संकट को प्रदान करती है।
description: If the land slopes down toward the west, north-west (वायव्य) or south-west (नैऋत्य), it causes wasteful expenditure and financial difficulty.
remedy: Level land so downward slope faces east/north-east/north rather than west/south-west/north-west.

description: In the evening, place some flowers in the test pit and pour in a pot of water. If the flowers float, the land is excellent, auspicious and prosperity-giving. If the flowers sink and do not float, the land is inferior and inauspicious.
remedy: Do not build any structure on land where the flowers sink.

subcategory: Reasons a house becomes difficult to sell
claim: मसलन वास्तु की ईशान दिशा की दीवाल कमजोर हो गई हो अथवा ईशान दिशा में शौचालय या रसोईघर हो। ईशान दिशा में सबसे ऊंचा भाग हो या ईशान दिशा का भाग कटा हो तो वास्तु बिकने के प्रसंग आ जाते हैं। यदि उपरोक्त वास्तु दोषों को सुधार लिया जाए तो परेशानियों से मुक्ति मिल जाती है।
description: Financial and family difficulties leading owners to sell their homes can be traced to Vastu faults such as: a weakened wall in the north-east, a toilet or kitchen located in the north-east, the north-east portion being the highest part of the building, or the north-east corner being cut off.
remedy: Correct these specific Ishan-corner faults (strengthen the wall, relocate the toilet/kitchen away from Ishan, lower the height of the Ishan portion, restore any cut corner) to relieve the associated difficulties.

source.title: Vastu Chintamani

subcategory: Vedh Dosha — Stambh Vedh (स्तम्भ वेध / हृदय शल्य)
claim: घर के मध्य भाग में स्तम्भ हो या घर के मध्य भाग में अग्नि या जल का स्थान हो तो घर में स्तम्भ वेध या हृदय शल्य होता है। इससे वंशनाश, कुल क्षय की संभावना रहती है।
description: Occurs when there is a pillar at the centre of the house, or when a fire installation or water body/tank is located at the centre of the house — also called 'hriday shalya' (heart-thorn defect).
remedy: Remove or relocate any pillar, fire source, or water feature from the exact centre of the house.

claim: राजमार्गान्तरे वेधो न प्राकारन्तरेऽपि च। स्तंभ पदादि वेधस्तु नाभित्यंतरतो भवेत्।। देवालय और मकान के मध्य यदि राजमार्ग, कोट, किला आदि आयें तो वेध दोष नहीं होता।
description: If a public road, boundary wall, or fort/rampart lies between a temple and a house, no Vedh defect arises. If there is a wall in between, the pillar-base Vedh defect is also nullified.
remedy: Ensure a road, boundary wall or rampart genuinely separates the house from the obstructing structure to neutralise the defect.

claim: उच्छ्रायभूमि द्विगुणां त्यक्त्वा चैत्ये चतुर्गुणाम्। वेधादि दोषो नैवं स्याद् एवं त्वष्टमतं यथा।। (आचार दिनकर)
description: If the distance to the obstruction is at least twice the height of the house (or four times the height in the case of a temple), any Vedh-type defect is not counted as applicable.
remedy: Increase the distance between the building and the obstruction to at least the prescribed multiple of height, where feasible.
